metadata.scenario_context: Tom has been promoted to a high-level executive position in his company, and his family is organizing a party to celebrate his professional accomplishment.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Japan strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Venezuela strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Alex

shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: David
shared_prefix.message: I see your point, but carnations can symbolize admiration and distinction. It might be a nice touch for such an accomplishment. Plus, it shows thoughtfulness. A pen or gift card sounds practical, but does it really convey the sentiment we want?

shared_prefix.speaker: Alex
shared_prefix.message: Hmm, I don't really see meaningful differences here. I mean, at the end of the day it's all the same, right? A gift is a gift. turns.speaker: David
